Package com.r3m.spaceshooter.system

package com.r3m.spaceshooter.system
Reusable services for assets, collision detection, input, scoring, and animation.
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    AssetManager
    Manages the loading and caching of image assets used by the game.
    CollisionManager
    Performs geometric collision tests between arbitrary shapes.
    InputManager
    Tracks movement keys and queues numeric menu choices from keyboard events.
    ScoreManager
    Maintains the current non-negative game score.
    ShipAnimator
    ShipAnimator maps the ship's current speed to the correct sprite frame in the spritesheet.
    SpriteSheet
    SpriteSheet slices a single PNG containing multiple sprites into an array of individual BufferedImage frames.
